en: Veteran Sergeant Longinus spent weeks cut off from his squad in one of the many engagements on Thur’Abis Plateau. During the time, he accounted for countless Necron warrior deaths, tirelessly battling the Xenos until his position was located. After returning to the Blood Ravens stronghold on the planet, the Techmarines were taken aback by Longinus's refusal to part with his pistol – his only companion during those dark days.
zh_new: 老兵軍士朗基努斯在圖爾阿比斯高原的一場交戰中與小隊失聯數週。在那段時間裡，他不知擊殺了多少太空死靈戰士，不懈地與異族作戰，直到己方定位到他的位置。返回該星球上的血鴉據點後，技術軍士們驚訝地發現朗基努斯拒絕交出手槍；那是他在黑暗歲月中的唯一伴侶。

en: A relic of battles against the dread Necrons, Brother Damon of the Blood Ravens 4th company used this weapon during Captain Thule's daring raid on the catacombs beneath the Thur'Abis Plateau. Damon – now a sergeant – would go on to wield the weapon during the Kaurava campaign.
zh_new: 這是對抗可怖太空死靈之戰的聖物。血鴉第四連的戴蒙兄弟曾在圖勒連長大膽突襲圖爾阿比斯高原地下墓穴時使用此武器。如今已成為軍士的戴蒙，後來在考拉瓦戰役中也繼續揮舞它。

en: Tarkus earned Terminator Honors during the assault on the Necron Catacombs under Thur’Abis Plateau. Tarkus was among those selected to protect the detonator that brought the entire cavern down on top of the Necrons.
zh_new: 塔庫斯在突擊圖爾阿比斯高原下方的太空死靈地下墓穴時贏得終結者榮譽。他是被選中保護引爆器的戰士之一，正是那枚引爆器讓整座洞窟塌落，將太空死靈埋葬其中。
